comparison.objective: Install an O-ring over a hydraulic plug thread and seat it square and untwisted in its groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled elastomer stretching, symmetric placement, release, and correction of a cocked ring.
comparison.success_condition: Ring is fully seated and released without exceeding 50% stretch or leaving more than 90 degrees of roll/twist.
comparison.reason: This is deformable seal installation with stretch and twist damage limits. The candidate is a rigid-body adjustment-and-lock task whose outcome is measured through carriage impacts.
